summary: Move `vi.unstubAllGlobals()` into `afterEach` (alongside `vi.restoreAllMocks()`) so global `navigator` stubs are always restored even if an assertion or call earlier in the test rejects.

Consider anchoring the `import`/`export` statement regex (`/(?:import|export)\s+[\s\S]*?from\s+['"][^'"]+['"]/g`) to line starts after stripping comments so a file-header comment containing the words `import` or `export` cannot span across lines into a subsequent `import type ... from '.../src/...'` declaration.
